title: Hackers Exploit 10 Vulnerabilities Across Mitel, Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss Products
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added 10 security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, including five vulnerabilities impacting Mitel MiCollab that were disclosed last week.
